text:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE — PagerDuty alert triggered for service=inference-gateway-prod-usw2. 5xx rate spike >8% (1m). PD-INC-7890. @alex you're on rotation. :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): Acked. Looking now.

pagerbot: alex (oncall) acknowledged PD-INC-7890 (runbook: inference-5xx)

jamie (sre): Checking grafana — errors spike correlates with /v1/generate. 502s across multiple frontends. Any recent deploys?

maya (eng-runtime): No prod deploys from CI in the last 30m. Investigating autoscaler + proxy metrics.

alex (oncall): Sample upstream log: ```[2026-03-18T02:25:12Z] model-proxy upstream response=502 reason="connection reset by peer"``` — rolling through logs now.

jamie (sre): LB logs show marked TLS handshake errors and lots of TIME_WAIT sockets. Could be socket pool exhaustion. Can you paste proxy config?

alex (oncall): Bumping proxy pool env to 2000 while we triage: `kubectl patch deploy proxy --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"proxy","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONN","value":"2000"}] }]}}}}'`

pagerbot: autoscaler: emergency scale triggered — inference-gateway replicas 6 -> 12 (policy: emergency-scale)

maya (eng-runtime): Pushing a temporary route fallback: /v1/generate -> inference-variant-bypass-small to reduce model-pool pressure.

jamie (sre): Also disabling aggressive cache fills: `optimize.cache.fill=false` applied to gateways.

alex (oncall): Error rate falling: 9.2% -> 4.1% (2m). Watching.

luca-cs: FYI support: 4 customers opened tickets complaining about degraded response times. Notified them we're investigating.

maya (eng-runtime): Drafting short customer update now, will post to status page if impact persists.

jamie (sre): Initial hypothesis: outbound socket exhaustion from model-proxy to model-pool causing connection resets. Will follow up with RCA after stabilization.

alex (oncall): Mitigation effective — error-rate at 1.3%. Marking as mitigated but keeping incident open for 30m of stable telemetry.

incident-bot: Auto-check scheduled: if no reoccurrence in 30m, incident will auto-resolve.

luca-cs: Thanks — will send customer follow-up and collect impacted org IDs.

alex (oncall): Adding notes to PD incident (PD-INC-7890) and creating follow-up ticket for socket-pool tuning + tests.
